question: Does the passive ratio-two differential dump mechanism from CASE-008 survive a dimensional cryoresistive-copper fault/discharge screen on historical NCSX type circuits across every declared circuit, detection-delay, resistivity, and heat-capacity case?
assumptions: Historical NCSX modular coils were LN2-precooled copper windings, not superconducting coils. The bound m45r00 source does not establish the copper grade. This case models a cryoresistive converter-loss and controlled-discharge transient; it is not a quench calculation.

Resistance, self-inductance, conductor, current, and thermal scales come from the coherent NCSX conceptual-design m45r00 tables. The line terms in that source are design assumptions, and later 20/20/18-turn production-coil values are not mixed into the calculations.

SIMSOPT NCSX coil filaments paired with a c09r00-named boundary supply only field, force, centerline-length, and inter-type mutual-inductance surrogates. Revision equivalence to m45r00 is not established and the computed centerline-length mismatch is gated.

One converter voltage becomes zero at fault onset. Healthy converters hold their initial copper-and-line loss compensation until a chosen detection delay, when all sources are bypassed and both the private and shared dump branches connect. These protection settings are exploratory, not historical NCSX settings.

The comparator uses three chosen 0.05 ohm private resistors and no shared branches. The candidate adds three pair-shared passive resistors through an explicit K3 incidence matrix; the private resistance and all absolute constraints remain unchanged.

Each six-coil type circuit is represented by one adiabatic copper temperature. NIST OFHC-copper heat capacity and 8960 kg/m3 density are model assumptions, not m45r00 material specifications. The NIST heat-capacity fit is swept at its plus or minus five-percent fit-error endpoints; the intrinsic resistivity curve is anchored to the published 85 K value and swept over a chosen plus or minus 15-percent model envelope.

Magnetic-shape departure removes the least-squares common-current field scale. Inter-coil filament-force-shape departure removes the corresponding common-scale-squared force pattern and omits singular self/hoop force. These are reduced filament proxies rather than plasma or structural analyses.

The 2 kV component-voltage threshold is a provisional screen borrowed from a later production-design operating-voltage datum whose terminal-to-terminal or terminal-to-ground reference is unspecified. It is not an established insulation limit for m45r00.
Thresholds and candidates were selected during interactive feasibility work before formal lineage capture. This is an exploratory falsification test, not preregistered confirmation.

Passing would justify an explicit switched-netlist, local thermal, grounding, structural, and plasma-response study. It would not establish safety, manufacturability, novelty, patentability, or commercial value.

requirements.statement: The candidate improves the worst magnetic-shape departure by at least 1.5 times relative to the same private-dump network without shared branches.

The candidate improves the worst inter-coil filament-force-shape departure by at least 1.5 times relative to the same private-dump network without shared branches; singular self/hoop force is outside this surrogate.

Every circuit remains below the conceptual-design table's 5.3e8 ampere-squared-second circuit rating, used here as a provisional screen rather than a demonstrated fault-survival limit, including the piecewise-linear bound prehistory.
The lumped winding temperature does not exceed the conceptual-design 125 K limit.
No modeled circuit exceeds the published conceptual-design 24 kA rating.
No modeled circuit current reverses sign.
The maximum modeled component voltage remains below a provisional 2 kV screen borrowed from a later production design; its voltage reference is unspecified.
At most one ten-thousandth of the initial magnetic energy remains after three seconds.
The maximum relative electrical energy-balance residual is at most 1e-5.

Across all fault and delay cases at nominal material properties, halving the transient time step changes no gated physical aggregate or per-scenario field/force peak by more than 0.1 percent; the roundoff-scale energy-balance residual has its own absolute gate.

Across all fault and delay cases at nominal material properties, the 256-to-512-segment confirmation refinement changes no gated physical aggregate or per-scenario field/force peak by more than one percent; the roundoff-scale energy-balance residual has its own absolute gate.
The off-diagonal mutual-inductance Frobenius norm changes by no more than 0.5 percent under the 256-to-512-segment confirmation refinement.
The dimensional fine circuit-inductance matrix has condition number no greater than three.
The c09r00 surrogate centerline lengths differ from the m45r00 dimensional lengths by no more than one percent; this does not establish revision equivalence.
The assumed NIST heat-capacity enthalpy curve internally reproduces the published deposited-energy/final-temperature mapping within two percent; this is not a physical temperature-accuracy claim.

categorical_requirements.statement: The declared private and shared resistor network is passive and its incidence-matrix power identity holds.
The checker covers all three faulted converters, five delays, three resistivity scales, and three heat-capacity scales.
